events.meaning: Superwall decided not to present a paywall for the request.

params.description: Superwall skip reason, lower snake_case of the SDK case name (e.g. no_audience_match, holdout).

user_properties.name: sub_tier
user_properties.description: Subscription tier: entitled now, lapsed (subscribed before, not now), free (never subscribed), or unknown (not resolved yet). Trial and paid are not distinguished.

user_properties.name: quota_state
user_properties.description: Free-workout meter: unlimited (not metered), metered (free workouts left), exhausted (none left), lapsed (former subscriber, no allowance).

user_properties.name: workouts_used
user_properties.description: Workouts counted by the meter, as a decimal string; the whole library when lapsed; unset when unlimited.

user_properties.name: app_build
user_properties.description: Build flavour of the install. Every cookbook query excludes debug.
